mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(c.id) AS id, c.course_code AS courseCode, c.course_name AS courseName, c.term_code AS termCode, m.member_role AS memberRole FROM edudoc_course_member m JOIN edudoc_course c ON c.id = m.course_id AND c.status = 'A' WHERE m.user_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND m.status = 'A' ORDER BY c.course_code
